70qr:
The International Year Two Business is a two-semester programme equivalent to the second year of a Scottish undergraduate honours degree which provides a route to year three (some exceptions apply) at the University of Strathclyde.

When students successfully complete the International Year Two programme, They can progress to the third year of a four-year BA degree or the second year of the three-year accelerated BBA degree at the University of Strathclyde.

This degree will prepare students for leadership roles in this dynamic industry which generates £5 billion to the Scottish economy and creates one in 10 jobs. They’ll have the skills to manage operations and business across a range of industries including hospitality, tourism and events.
